notes_for_editor: Only tower-specific source is one index line (name, county, coordinates, codes; the index's elevation of 555 has no unit, and the record's 169.2 m matches feet). It gives no build date, height, operator, status or access. Two search snippets (governmentstate.org and countyoffice.org; neither could be fetched, one DNS failure and one 403) list a 'Fire Tower' at 5720 GA Highway 41, Preston, at the same address as a Georgia Forestry Commission Webster County unit. Not cited, since the pages are not cached and the link to this tower is unconfirmed. Worth a manual check, because it may be the tower's address and would support a site-today paragraph. BLL and gfc codes are not defined in any source found. Story is short because the evidence is thin.
